title: 決して～ない
shortExplanation: Express 'never', 'by no means', or 'not at all' when negating a statement.
longExplanation: The 決して～ない grammar point is used to emphasize a negative statement or action. It can be translated as 'never', 'by no means', or 'not at all'. This grammar point must be paired with a negative verb form to maintain its negative meaning.

examples.jp: 彼は決して遅刻しない。
この秘密を決して誰にも言わないでください。
examples.romaji: Kono himitsu o kesshite darenimo iwanai de kudasai.
examples.en: Please never tell this secret to anyone.

examples.jp: 決して諦めないで、最後までがんばりましょう。
examples.romaji: Kesshite akiramenai de, saigo made ganbarimashou.
examples.en: Never give up and keep trying until the end.

examples.jp: 彼女は決して嘘をつかない人です。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa kesshite uso o tsukanai hito desu.
examples.en: She is a person who never lies.

usageNote: Emphatic "never/by no means" - stronger and more deliberate than ぜんぜん; common in writing and serious statements.
